name: Alabama Woodworkers Guild, Inc.
old_description: Our Mission is to promote and administer programs which will benefit the woodworking community and advance the art and craft of woodworking.
about:
The Alabama Woodworkers Guild, Inc. was founded in 1983 by a group of woodworkers in Shelby County, Alabama. The organization incorporated in November 2004 and received 501(c)(3) charitable status in February 2005. Its Woodworking Education Center (WEC) is housed in the former Maylene School building on Highway 17 in Maylene, where the guild moved in 2007 and held a grand opening in May 2008.

The guild operates the WEC as a shared workshop equipped with professional-grade machinery not typically found in home shops, including a Bridgewood 12-inch jointer, a SawStop table saw, a Grizzly 20-inch planer, and a Bosch 12-inch compound sliding miter saw. The facility is open Friday through Sunday for members and visitors when a supervisor is on duty. The guild holds general membership meetings on the third Saturday of each month from January through November, featuring presentations, show-and-tell sessions, and mentorship time. Additional activities include CNC/laser group meetings, hand-tool sessions, luthier and toy-building groups, seminars with professional woodworkers, an annual juried show, shop tours, and a monthly newsletter.

Membership is open to anyone aged 13 or older with an interest in woodworking, regardless of tool ownership or experience level. The guild serves hobbyists, beginners, and master craftsmen alike, and its toy-building program donates finished pieces to children’s hospitals and other agencies. Visitors are welcome at meetings and at the WEC during supervised hours.

The guild’s stated mission is to promote and administer programs that benefit the woodworking community and advance the art and craft of woodworking. It was started to provide a forum for woodworkers to share skills, access specialized equipment, and fellowship with peers.

name: Alamo Food Equipment-Supplies
old_description: is your one-stop place to shop for new and used meat processing equipment and supplies.
about:
Alamo Food Equipment & Supplies, Inc. operates from Schertz, Texas, serving as a supplier of meat processing equipment and consumables. The company's founding year and ownership structure are not publicly disclosed.

The business functions as a one-stop distributor for both new and used meat processing machinery, carrying brands such as Biro, Mainca, Promark, Minipack, Treif, and Risco. Its equipment lineup includes grinders, mixer grinders, band saws, vacuum sealers, stuffers, tumblers, tenderizers, slicers, dicers, bowl choppers, and metal detectors. In addition to hardware, the company stocks a broad range of consumables: vacuum pouches and films in multiple thicknesses, freezer paper, butcher paper, patty paper, steak paper, wax sheets, collagen and cellulose casings, seasoning blends, cures, spices, and butcher supplies such as saw blades, gloves, and tapes.

Customers span the meat and food processing sectors, including butcher shops, sausage makers, and commercial food processors that require both capital equipment and daily consumables. The company's catalog addresses needs from small-scale patty forming to industrial smokehouse operations.

Alamo positions itself as a single source for new and used equipment alongside a full slate of packaging and seasoning supplies, aiming to simplify procurement for food processing operations.

name: Alaska Spiritwear LLC/ FISHAK
old_description: Alaska State Fair starts August 21, 2026. Shop will only be open on Tuesdays during the fair. Orders are shipped using USPS Ground Advantage to keep shipping cost down.
about:
Alaska Spiritwear LLC, operating under the FishAK brand, is based in Anchorage, Alaska. The company sells branded apparel and accessories through its e-commerce site AlaskanShirts.com, offering a range of Alaska-themed designs on t-shirts, hoodies, hats, drinkware, and lanyards.

The product catalog includes tri-blend adult and youth t-shirts, midweight hoodies, Richardson trucker hats, UPF 50 long-sleeve shirts, stainless-steel tumblers, and retractable lanyards. Orders are fulfilled and shipped via USPS Ground Advantage to minimize shipping costs, and the physical shop opens only on Tuesdays during the annual Alaska State Fair.

The business serves individual consumers seeking Alaska-inspired lifestyle merchandise, with designs referencing local fishing culture, hockey, and humorous slogans. There is no indication of wholesale, contract manufacturing, or B2B supply arrangements in the available information.

No founding year, ownership structure, or stated mission beyond selling Alaska-themed goods is provided in the source material.

name: Alder & Company
old_description: Alder and Company LLC, offers high quality furnishings designed to create elegant surroundings.
about:
Alder & Company, based in Bakersfield, California, was established on August 11, 2004. The limited-liability company operates under the Alder & Co. brand and focuses on the design and production of furnishings. The founding year is explicitly stated on the company's homepage, though the names of the founders and ownership structure are not disclosed.

The company produces high-quality furniture in Country French, Country English, and Italian styles, with the ability to customize most requests. Each piece is handmade, and the company emphasizes its finishing process as the benchmark of every item. The homepage also references "Benchmark Furniture," suggesting a product line or quality standard associated with the brand. No facility size, headcount, or production volumes are published.

Alder & Company serves customers seeking elegant surroundings through its furnishings. While specific industries are not detailed in public materials, the product line addresses residential, commercial, and hospitality settings where custom-designed furniture is specified. The company's messaging centers on creating elegant surroundings rather than targeting a particular sector.

The company distinguishes itself through its signature finish, which it describes as the true benchmark of each handmade item, and through a willingness to tailor designs to client specifications. This focus on finish and customization is presented as the core of its value proposition.

name: AleSmith Brewing Company
old_description: Brews craft beer on an 85 bbl system in San Diego and offers contract beverage manufacturing (beer, seltzer, hard tea, RTDs) through its Anvil Beverage division.
about:
AleSmith Brewing Company was founded in 1995 in San Diego, California, driven by a passion and respect for brewing. The brewery began on Miramar Road and has since grown into a production facility with an 85-barrel brewhouse.

Today the company operates that 85-barrel system to produce a wide range of year-round, seasonal, and limited-release craft beers — flagship Speedway Stout, IPA, San Diego Pale Ale, hazy IPAs, fruited lagers, and a series of barrel-aged stouts. In addition to its own labels, AleSmith runs the Anvil Beverage division, which offers contract manufacturing for beer, hard seltzer, hard tea, and ready-to-drink cocktails, including canning services.

AleSmith’s branded beers reach consumers through a wholesale distribution network, while the Anvil Beverage division works with other beverage companies that need production and packaging capacity. The brewery also operates a tasting room and private event space on site, but its B2B focus centers on contract brewing and co-packing for external brands.

The company highlights its collaborative approach, pointing to partnerships with breweries such as Omnipollo, and a community program called Anvil of Hope as reflections of its founding ethos.
